component.name: Light Player
component.summary: Play and organize your local media library

description.p: Light Player is a cross-platform desktop media player. Scan your local folders into a browsable music and video library, build playlists, and enjoy playback with cover art, lyrics, chapters, and subtitles.

ul.li: Browse music by song, album, and artist, or browse videos by folder
Create and manage music and video playlists
Open audio and video files directly from your file manager
